_note: Desk 4 session end → full tray loop. Align gate at 0 before show. Each pulse = one step. slideCount pulses: 0→1→…→(slideCount) then next show starts at that position — for 0→1→…→80→0 use slideCount 81 (80 steps to slide 80, +1 back to 0). If tray goes 0→80 (reverse), invertDirection + reverseRelayChannel, or rewire Forward to relayChannel.
